stem: According to standard organ-specific indication references, isolated pancreas transplantation is indicated for which patient population?

options.text: Patients with labile type 1 or type 2 diabetes mellitus, or to halt or prevent secondary complications of diabetes
Patients with isolated end-stage renal disease without diabetes
Patients with reversible acute kidney injury requiring short-term dialysis only
Patients with untreated active bloodstream infection

explanation.rationale_correct: Pancreas transplantation is indicated for labile type 1 or type 2 diabetes or to halt or prevent secondary diabetic complications; simultaneous kidney/pancreas transplant is indicated when ESRD is also present.

rationale_incorrect.B: Isolated ESRD without diabetes is an indication for kidney transplant, not isolated pancreas transplant.
rationale_incorrect.C: Reversible acute kidney injury alone does not define pancreas transplant candidacy.
rationale_incorrect.D: Active untreated infection is a contraindication to transplantation, not an indication for pancreas transplant.

primary_anchor.section: Ch. 1, Organ-specific indications → G. Pancreas transplantation or simultaneous kidney/pancreas transplantation → item 1
primary_anchor.quote_hint: Pancreas transplantation is indicated for patients with labile type 1 or type 2 diabetes mellitus

references.citation: Core Curriculum for Transplant Nurses, 2nd ed. (Cupples et al., 2016).
references.locator: Ch. 1 → G. Pancreas transplantation or simultaneous K/P (isolated pancreas indications); PDF p. 50 (repo file-page index; printed margin may differ).

notes: Source-first item. First pancreas organ tag in bank; anchor verified on Cupples p. 50.

stem: During a liver transplant evaluation, the psychologist recommends additional specialty input before a final team decision. Which coordinator action aligns with standard evaluation references?

options.text: Facilitate additional consultations such as infectious disease or cardiology based on transplant team recommendations
Proceed to listing without any further consultations regardless of team input
Limit evaluation testing to chest radiography only
Defer all psychosocial assessment permanently after initial screening

explanation.rationale_correct: Transplant evaluation references state that additional medical consultations may be required based on recommendations from transplant team members, including psychologists, infectious disease specialists, and cardiologists.

rationale_incorrect.B: Team-recommended consultations are part of compiling multidisciplinary evaluation recommendations.
rationale_incorrect.C: Evaluation includes organ-specific diagnostic protocols beyond chest radiography alone.
rationale_incorrect.D: Psychosocial evaluation remains part of living donor and candidate assessment pathways.

primary_anchor.section: Ch. 3, Patient Education → evaluation process → viii. Other medical consultations
primary_anchor.quote_hint: Other medical consultations may be required based on recommendations from transplant team members

references.citation: Core Curriculum for Transplant Nurses, 2nd ed. (Cupples et al., 2016).
references.locator: Ch. 3 → evaluation process → viii. Other medical consultations (psychologist, ID, cardiology, etc.); PDF p. 97 (repo file-page index; printed margin may differ).

notes: Source-first item. Distinct 020200 angle from cctc-2006 (PRA frequency); anchor verified on Cupples p. 97.

stem: A deceased-donor kidney becomes available and the allocation system generates an offer for an listed candidate. Where is relevant donor information made available for the transplant team's acceptance decision?

options.text: The candidate's personal health record portal only
A paper fax sent exclusively to the dialysis unit without transplant center access
The SRTR public outcomes website at the moment of offer

explanation.rationale_correct: Relevant information about a potential deceased donor is made available to transplant programs through DonorNet for physician decision-making, while refusal documentation is required when offers are declined.

rationale_incorrect.B: Offer-time donor data flows through the UNOS allocation and DonorNet systems, not solely the candidate portal.
rationale_incorrect.C: Transplant programs receive donor offer information centrally via DonorNet.
rationale_incorrect.D: SRTR provides program outcomes data but is not the real-time organ-offer presentation system.

primary_anchor.section: Ch. 5, Allocation of Deceased Donor Kidneys → DonorNet offer paragraph
primary_anchor.quote_hint: Relevant information about a potential donor is made available to transplant programs on a Web-based program called DonorNet

references.locator: Ch. 5 → DonorNet paragraph (donor information available to programs for acceptance decisions); PDF p. 113 (repo file-page index; printed margin may differ).

notes: Source-first item. Distinct 020600 angle from cctc-2004 (refusal codes); anchor verified on Danovitch p. 113.

stem: A kidney transplant candidate is completing pre-operative evaluation before scheduled surgery. Which study is performed to establish a preoperative urinary baseline?

options.text: Urine volume, protein, microscopy, and culture and sensitivity
Coronary angiography for every candidate regardless of cardiac history

explanation.rationale_correct: Kidney transplant preoperative evaluation includes specific urine testing with volume, protein, microscopy, and culture and sensitivity to establish a baseline before surgery.

rationale_incorrect.B: LAS applies to lung allocation, not kidney preoperative urine studies.
rationale_incorrect.C: Cardiac testing is individualized; universal coronary angiography is not the described urine baseline requirement.
rationale_incorrect.D: PELD is a pediatric liver allocation score, not a kidney preoperative urine study.

primary_anchor.section: Ch. 1, Kidney transplantation → preoperative evaluation → 5.a.i. Specific urine tests
primary_anchor.quote_hint: Urine volume, protein, microscopy, and culture and sensitivity are assessed to establish a preoperative baseline
